title: HeartbeatResponse
description: The coordinator's heartbeat reply (protocols.md §6): an optional self-update manifest and planner notes. `update` conforms to update-manifest.schema.json when present (defined with the self-update channel, §7).

update.description: null ⇒ up to date; otherwise an update-manifest (see §7).

planner_notes.description: Advisory suggestions from the planner (never silent changes).
